name: Koga Shinichi
source:
Touzaka University 4th Year, Literature Major, Art Club leader.

"Matsubayashi is too long. Can I call you Asami? ...San?"

Asami's classmate and the charismatic leader of the art club. Street smart and shrewd with an approachable disposition, his peers respect him for his seniority and skill in the arts and literature. A former student of a fine arts university 'BiDai', Shinichi is two years older despite being in the same school year as Asami. For some reason, she treats him coldly and his joke always roll off her back.

[From [url=https://precatio.wordpress.com/characters/]official site[/url]]
